title: JobPhases
description: Data file content/jobs/phases.json: which phases of the game day are the compute night of the AI service (B7 S4, D471 D4). The core signals the change from the world calendar, so it is the same in every run.

night_day_phases.description: Day phases (vocabulary time_of_day) that count as compute night.

wait_for_sleepers_hours.description: B2680 (Marcel W1939): the compute night begins when every inhabitant sleeps, at the latest this many game hours after nightfall (the start of the first night phase); the night scene of the game waits the same (look/night.json wait_for_sleepers_max_h). Omitted = at nightfall, as before.
